CLN-009.note: scikit-learn's bundled copy of UCI WDBC: first line is '569,30,malignant,benign' metadata; label 0=malignant, 1=benign (sklearn encoding, inverse of the UCI M/B letter). Benchmarks treat malignant (label 0) as the positive class.

breast_cancer_wisconsin_diagnostic.zip.note: Canonical UCI file: id, diagnosis (M/B), then the same 30 features as the scikit-learn copy.

CLN-001.note: Processed Cleveland subset (303 rows). num 0 = no disease, 1-4 = disease; binarised as num > 0. ca/thal have a few missing values (imputed in-fold).

CLN-002.note: Pima Indians Diabetes (OpenML 37). Zeros in plas/pres/skin/insu/mass are physiologically implausible and are documented missing-value codes; left as-is to match the plan (no reduction), noted as a limitation.

CLN-003.note: Diabetes 130-US hospitals. Target for E4 is 30-day readmission (readmitted == '<30'). patient_nbr repeats across encounters, so splits are grouped on it.

CLN-006.note: The UCI zip holds Chronic_Kidney_Disease.rar; no RAR extractor is installed in this environment, so it was not parsed.

CLN-007.note: ILPD has no header row; selector 1 = liver patient, 2 = non-patient (UCI documentation). ag_ratio has 4 missing values.

CLN-008.note: HCV data; Category is 5-class (blood donor, suspect donor, hepatitis, fibrosis, cirrhosis). First column is a row index.

CLN-010.note: 'time' is follow-up length and is known to leak the outcome; exclude it from any predictive model.

CLN-011.note: Missing values are coded '?'. Hinselmann/Schiller/Citology are alternative targets and must be dropped when Biopsy is the target.

CLN-013.note: Open ODbL demo (100 patients). Parsed table: hosp/admissions; grouped by subject_id. Very few positives, so it is a pipeline smoke test, not a benchmark.
